snippet.title: Frosthaven | Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
The full 1.0 version of FROSTHAVEN is available now on PC (Steam and Epic Games Store)!

Get it on Steam: https://bit.ly/4ujmQ6X
Get it on the Epic Games Store: https://store.epicgames.com/p/frosthaven-0aa6b6?lang=en-US

Adventure lies beyond the town of Frosthaven. Select your party, gear up, and uncover what awaits in the Frozen North.

Developed by Snapshot Games in collaboration with Cephalofair Games, FROSTHAVEN brings the acclaimed board game to life in a faithful digital adaptation of the dark fantasy tactical RPG.

Stride into battle with 17 unique heroes, experience a massive campaign, and adventure with friends like never before in this evolution of the acclaimed board game by Isaac Childres and Cephalofair Games! Explore diverse environments and rich combat encounters with a variety of abilities and character classes that make every decision paramount for a challengingly satisfying journey alone or with friends in online co-op multiplayer.

Watch: https://www.youtube.com/@ArcGamesEurope
Follow: https://x.com/PlayFrosthaven 
Like: https://www.facebook.com/FrosthavenGame 
Discuss: https://discord.gg/FUNmzWVfz2
